caption: The video showcases a magnetic-ball construction on a white surface, an outer cube frame of small steel spheres with open square faces enclosing an inner star-shaped polyhedron of bar magnets joined at larger spherical nodes. The construction is already changing orientation in view as the clip opens, its tilted open square face gradually becoming near-frontal and upright while the gridded side on the right foreshortens. The internal star reorients in sync with the cube, its vertex spheres and bar arms shifting across the opening and its pointed tips moving around the silhouette rather than appearing or vanishing. The whole object's image-plane tilt decreases steadily throughout, consistent with a shifting viewpoint. A faint background edge line at the upper left drifts out of view as the angle changes. No hands, tools, or deformation appear.
